messages:
incident-bot: PAGER -> metering-ingest-high-lag: consumer lag > 1.2M, delayed usage emits, customers seeing overage flags. Severity: P2. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/metering-ingest

erin-ops: I’m on it. jumping onto the consumer pod logs

sam-sre: thx erin. can you post consumer group lag, and which partition hotspots?

erin-ops: consumer lag snapshot:
```
consumer_group: metering-consumer-g1
lag: 1,247,893
top partitions: topic-metering-0 (420k), topic-metering-3 (330k), topic-metering-5 (210k)
``` 

sam-sre: ok scaling consumers x3 for now. running:
`kubectl scale deploy/metering-consumer --replicas=9 -n prod` 

mike-billing: customers have started getting overage flags; can we pause notifications? /cc @oliver-cs

erin-ops: billing-bot: `pause-overage-notifications --scope=prod --reason="ingest-backlog"` -> triggered :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Overages paused for prod. Will not auto-send alerts for 2h. (manual resume required) :no_bell:

oliver-cs: creating a short CS template to notify impacted customers (those with >1000 delayed tokens). Will share for review.

nina-pm: any ETA on backfill? need to update status page if >30m

sam-sre: once replicas come up lag should drop in ~10-20m; backfill job queued for low-priority partitions. kicking `backfill-worker --range=topic-metering:0-5 --priority=high`

erin-ops: logs show consumer restarted and caught up ~8% in last 2m. tail:
```
[10:02:31] consumer-metrics: processed 45k tokens/s
[10:03:12] consumer-metrics: processed 120k tokens/s
[10:04:05] lag remaining: ~720k
```

mike-billing: good. confirm we won't double-count when backfill writes? Are dedupe keys intact?

sam-sre: yes dedupe by event_id + kvcache checkpointing. doing a small verification run on partition 0 before full backfill.

erin-ops: verification passed on partition 0. backfill started. tracking job id = bf-2026-04-08-01

incident-bot: NOTE -> customer-impact: some customers saw transient overage flags but billing amounts unchanged until recon completes. Follow postmortem checklist: incident severity review, timeline, mitigations.

oliver-cs: shared draft to #customer-communications for approval. keep me posted if we need to escalate to account execs.

nina-pm: updating status page: "Degraded: delayed usage reporting; mitigation in progress."

sam-sre: monitoring. will follow up when lag < 10k. tagging for handoff to next on-call in ~40m @erin-ops

erin-ops: copying notes to incident channel and handing off to @sam-sre for overnight watch. leaving a runbook pointer and job ids.

erin-ops: HANDOFF NOTES: scaled metering-consumer -> 9 replicas; backfill job bf-2026-04-08-01 started; billing notifications paused; CS draft in #customer-communications.

sam-sre: ACK. will keep watch and resume notifications when reconciled. please add any anomalies to the postmortem doc.

mike-billing: thanks team. any customers actually billed incorrectly? if so we need immediate refunds.

sam-sre: initial check: no invoice charges applied yet; system flags only. will run final verification before resuming alerts.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE -> status: mitigations applied. next update at 11:00Z or on significant change.
